alpinemedia.tokenSource: the token is NOT in the repository: set ALPINEMEDIA_TOKEN_DARTMOUTH_SKIWAY in liftie's environment (liftie.service Environment=). Its value is the public client key (expo config extra.apiKey) in the JavaScript bundle loaded by https://dartmouth-skiway.app.alpinemedia.com/embed/lifts-trails/conditions; read 2026-11-17.
alpinemedia.rotates: may change with any app release: a 401, an empty board or an unset variable is an error; re-read the key from the current bundle and update the variable
